response.description:
Effective March 31, 2027, the Emissions Impact Dashboard for Azure hosted by Power BI will be
retired. After this date, the dashboard will no longer be accessible and
technical support will be discontinued. We strongly encourage customers
to export their emissions data to retain historical reporting. Customers can explore Azure
Carbon Optimizer in advance of the retirement date as an alternative solution.  Learn more: Carbon optimization
in Azure Azure
Carbon Optimization community feedback
response.title: Retirement: Emissions Impact Dashboard for Azure
